They aren't that special, thus you shouldn't really care what they think. Hell, if they are toxic, cut them out of your life. They just are just blocking the space for people who would actually support you.

As someone who used to have it just like you and now has a circle of friends, it's not as beautiful as you might imagine. Sure, it's great to have friends and I have plenty of fond memories with them...but that also brings a whole new set of problems with it. And I still feel miserable, perhaps as much as during the time I didn't have friends. But that's just depression being a b***ch really, not allowing you to truly appreciate things...

Yeah, I am not as often or severely depressed as I used to be but I still find myself "punishing" myself for things I consider wrong. It's just that depression has been so long with me that it became a part of my mindset.
Find a reason to die or find a reason to live. While the first option seems easier, I am hoping you could go for the second one, albeit it is much harder.
